note: Tokiwasan Maru (1,804 t) and Shoryu Maru (1,916 t) of convoy No. 3905, Yokosuka to Haha-jima, both sunk. BANG claimed a medium AK and a medium AO (Attacks 1-2, 1616-1632 K). Secondary source only

japanese.translation: Convoy No. 3905 (Yokosuka to Haha-jima; escorts Yasojima, Hachijo, CD-4, CD-12): BANG torpedoes and sinks both Tokiwasan Maru and Shoryu Maru at 28-58N 137-45E

note: No. 2 Tosei Maru (507-ton tanker) of convoy TAKA-909 sunk. BANG claimed one AK sunk and another probably sunk (Attacks 3-4); the escorts claimed BANG sunk

japanese.original: 海防三〇、掃一五、三拓南丸、七利丸、太安丸、三号太平丸 タカ九〇九船団護衛 / 海防三〇、太安丸陸軍飛行機ト共ニN二四─五四 E一二二─二三ニ於テタカ九〇九船団ヲ雷撃セル敵潜水艦攻撃 / 被害 第二東勢丸沈没 戦果 敵潜水艦一隻撃沈
japanese.translation: CD-30, W-15, No. 3 Takunan Maru, Shichiri Maru, Taian Maru, No. 3 Taihei Maru: escorting convoy TAKA-909. / CD-30 and Taian Maru, with army aircraft, attack the enemy submarine that torpedoed convoy TAKA-909 at N 24°54′ E 122°23′. / Damage: No. 2 Tosei Maru sunk. Result: one enemy submarine sunk
